items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: We had Johnny Dots playing clarinet.

ctx.x: David Jones playing alto, mellophone and sax. We had Johnny Dots playing clarinet. We had Lilian Armstrong on piano. We had Minor Hall on drums, and we had Notre Dutre on trombone, and myself on bass, and King Oliver was playing. That's the way the band was picked up when we went to Frisco, playing at the Procola dance hall.
And when you came west, did you plan to stay here, or did you just come for a short trip? Well, we come to play that engagement, that's all.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: He come on over there. Johnny come on over there and... Fitted in all right with us. Start the playin'.

ctx.x: So I walked up there, uh,

the... How would you like to play in the band? Who are you playing with? I ain't playing with nobody. You know, they come from over, Bay St. Louis. So I ain't playing with nobody. How would you like to play with a... Kid Horry. I wanna call him Horry's band. I said, all right. I said, will you come to rehearsal? He said, yeah. So I told him... That I'd see Horry, and I'd seen Horry and told him Horry. I said, I think he'll be all right, Horry. So... Well, he said, have him come on over. We have rehearsal. We have…
This is Johnny which? Johnny Dodge.

items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: So I told Ory, I said, 'I heard a guy who sounds pretty good to me.' Sounded pretty good. 'All right. Call him over and I'll call a rehearsal.' So he had a rehearsal and had Johnnie come over, he came out there and got on the band,

ctx.x: Johnnie was working on a furniture wagon. I seen him sitting on the tailgate, playing his horn, you know, running over his clarinet. I sat there for a little while.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: We had Roy, Joe, Johnny Dodge, Ram, it's mine and all, myself, and Lil.

ctx.x: That's pretty good. And I went on over and I got Joe, then we organized the band. So we had Joe Oliver, Nora Dutre. Well first we had Roy before Nora come back. We had Roy, Joe, Johnny Dodge, Ram, it's mine and all, myself, and Lil. Who else? Who else? That's all. That's all. Joe, Leo, Miner, Roy Palmer, myself, and the piano players. That was six years.
You said Lil' Kepard's were wanting to play guitar.
